who: Real stack · local stand-in for Stripe Billing
title: Usage-based billing on Stripe, without surprises
sub: Usage counted once, reported to Stripe's meter and reconciled, alerts before overage, spend caps, and failed payments handled with a grace period.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Stripe Billing (meters, subscriptions, signed webhooks) · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: A new customer on the Starter plan: created in Stripe with a subscription, API key shown once
The product sends usage. A batch retried after a timeout is counted once
Past 80% of the included calls: the customer gets an email. Then usage runs over
They set a spend cap. When the bill reaches it, the product is told to pause usage
Every event went to Stripe's meter. Reconciliation: our count and Stripe's agree
The period closes. The card is declined: past due, and after the grace period, paused
A new card, Stripe retries, the invoice is paid, and access is back at once
And every email the customer got along the way
